name: Kreativ Smart Related Posts
description: Show relevant related content based on context to increase discovery and engagement.
cardUse: Improve discovery and session depth with smarter internal recommendations.
metaDescription: Context-aware related post recommendations to improve content discovery and session depth.

detailItems.title: Context-aware recommendations
detailItems.body: Prioritize related posts using content context and topical proximity instead of static tag overlap alone.

detailItems.title: Flexible display controls
detailItems.body: Configure placement, limit, and presentation style to match different themes and content layouts.

detailItems.title: Engagement-focused defaults
detailItems.body: Designed to support longer sessions and stronger internal discovery without manual curation overhead.

ctaLines: Current status: Prototype direction is still under review. Planned after Internal Links Audit.
Follow our News page for release updates.

items.title: Sites that need better content discovery
items.body: This plugin is aimed at blogs, magazines, and documentation-style sites that want readers to discover more relevant content without hand-curating every related-post block.

items.title: Teams that want useful defaults
items.body: It is being designed for site owners who want stronger internal recommendations without building a custom recommendation system.

items.title: Generic related posts often miss context
items.body: Simple tag overlap or date-based widgets often produce low-value recommendations that do not improve session depth or content discovery.

items.title: Manual curation does not scale
items.body: The goal is to make related-post output feel relevant enough to support navigation and engagement without creating another maintenance burden.

items.title: What v1 will include
items.body: The first version is expected to focus on context-aware matching, basic display controls, and sensible defaults that work on typical content sites.

items.title: What v1 will not do
items.body: The initial release is not being positioned as a machine-learning recommendation engine or a full personalization platform. The scope stays intentionally practical.

homepageStatus: Prototype under review · Planned after Internal Links Audit
